title: Ekisiikirize Emabega Wa Nnamulondo
intro: Oyimiridde mu mpya z’obwakabaka obw’amaanyi obw’edda, omufuzi ow’amaanyi gye yeerangirira nga katonda w’abantu bonna. Ku mabbali g’omufuzi ono kuyimiriddewo omuweereza eyeewaddeyo, eyakwasibwa ebiruubirirwa by’obwakabaka ebisinga obukulu. Bombi, bakola olukwe era ne bateekateeka, nga bagaana okussaayo omwoyo ku kulabula kw’omubaka eyasindikibwa okubalung’amya. Osobola okuzuula omuweereza ono omwesigwa y’ani?
clues: Nnabeera mu bwakabaka obw’amaanyi obwali bufugibwa omuntu ow’amaanyi eyali yeeyita Katonda ku bantu bonna.
Naweereza ng’omuweereza ow’omufuzi ono eyeesigika, nga nkola buli kye baali baagala n’ekiragiro kyabwe.
Omubaka wa Allah bwe yajja mu nsi yaffe ng’atuyita mu mazima, nze n’omufuzi wange twagaana okuwuliriza.
Nnalagirwa okukuma omuliro omunene n’okuteekateeka amatoffaali g’ebbumba okusobola okuzimba ekifo ekinene.
Omufuzi wange yali ayagala okuzimba ekizimbe ekiwanvu ennyo ne kituuka mu ggulu lyenyini.
Ku nkomerero, nze n’omufuzi wange, amagye gaffe, twakulugguka ne tubbira mu buziba bw’ennyanja.

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
